_comment: Copy to profile.json (install.sh does it). {home} = this folder, {actions} = actions/, {page}/{key} = where the key sits. Keys 0-3 = top row, 4-7 = bottom row. Touch strips flip pages. Edit here or in the dashboard at http://127.0.0.1:8885

0.label: Mute
0.desc: mute or unmute the Mac's sound

1.label: Layout
1.desc: fix the SELECTED text that was typed in the wrong keyboard layout (Hebrew/English)

2.label: Screenshot
2.desc: take a screenshot of a screen area to the clipboard

3.label: Record
3.desc: start or stop recording a screen area

4.label: Calendar
4.desc: join the current or next meeting (opens its video link), or open the calendar

5.label: Focus
5.desc: start or stop a 25-minute focus timer

6.label: Claude
6.desc: open the Claude session that needs attention

7.label: Translate
7.desc: translate the SELECTED text (Hebrew to English, anything else to Hebrew)

0.label: Improve
0.desc: rewrite the SELECTED text so it reads better
